### Seri Maju Digital Sdn. Bhd. Summary

Seri Maju Digital Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated on 2003-02-27, operating in the technology industry with its listed state in Kuala Lumpur. Its nature of business is the development of accounting software for small businesses, backed by a share capital of RM2,500,000. 

Ownership is held by three individual shareholders: Director 2 holds 44.2%, Director 3 holds 42.8%, and Director 1 holds 13.0%. 

Financial performance across the multi-year period from 2022 to 2024 shows steady growth. Revenue increased from RM28,995,588 in 2022 to RM39,465,708 in 2023, and further reached RM56,636,796 in 2024. Profit after tax followed a similar upward trend, rising from RM2,605,767 in 2022 to RM3,431,002 in 2023, and reaching RM6,750,598 in 2024. 

The company maintained positive operating cash flows, increasing from RM3,387,116 in 2022 to RM3,652,526 in 2023, and RM7,537,380 in 2024. Cash balances stood at RM5,609,791 at the latest financial year-end. Audit opinions across all years were unqualified, issued by Audit Firm 4. There are no recorded litigation cases.

**Teguh Bestari Learning Sdn. Bhd.** is an active private limited company incorporated on December 7, 1991, operating in the education industry with its listed state as Selangor and its nature of business focusing on private kindergarten and nursery operations in Johor Bahru. The company has a share capital of RM2,500,000. Majority control is held by Director 1, who owns 51.02% of the shares, while Director 2 holds the remaining 48.98%.

Multi-year financial trends from 2022 to 2024 show consistent growth. Revenue expanded from RM2,976,052 in 2022 to RM4,101,556 in 2023, and further to RM5,606,840 by 2024. Profit after tax similarly increased from RM138,435 in 2022 to RM225,939 in 2023, reaching RM386,389 in 2024. Total assets grew from RM3,366,741 in 2022 to RM6,342,892 in 2024. 

The company maintained positive operating cash flows across the period, reporting RM249,746 in 2022, RM392,532 in 2023, and RM523,695 in 2024. Audit opinions were unqualified for 2022 and 2024, but received a disclaimer of opinion in 2023. No litigation cases or pending claims were reported.

**Indah Prima Medical Sdn. Bhd.** (Registration No. SYN-000148) is an active private limited company incorporated on April 30, 1993, operating within the healthcare industry in Kelantan with a share capital of RM500,000. Its primary business activity involves community pharmacies and health supplements. Director 4 holds majority control with a 75.61% ownership stake.

Financial performance across the multi-year period from 2022 to 2024 shows a declining trend in revenue, falling from RM5,529,168 in 2022 to RM5,340,763 in 2023, and further to RM4,835,417 in 2024. The company experienced deepening net losses over the same timeframe, recording a loss after tax of RM516,132 in 2022, RM824,436 in 2023, and RM1,080,511 in 2024. Operating cash flow remained negative throughout, worsening from RM136,351 in 2022 to RM818,980 by 2024. 

As of the latest 2024 financial position, the company holds total assets of RM6,804,198 against total liabilities of RM4,924,514, resulting in a total equity of RM1,879,684. Borrowings stand at RM963,913 alongside RM547,001 in cash. Audit Firm 5 issued unqualified audit opinions for all three financial years. There is no active litigation recorded.

**Jaya Mega Consulting Sdn. Bhd.** (Registration Number: SYN-001070) is an active private limited company incorporated on 19 April 2018, operating in the professional services industry from Selangor. Its stated nature of business is architectural design and planning services, with a share capital of RM500,000. 

Director 2 holds majority control with a 61.11% ownership stake, alongside Director 21.08% and Director 4 17.81%.

Financial records from 2022 to 2024 show consistent multi-year revenue growth:

### Pacific Seri Freight Sdn. Bhd. Summary

Pacific Seri Freight Sdn. Bhd. (Registration Number: SYN-001203) is an active private limited company incorporated on 2007-06-08 with a share capital of RM5,000,000. Listed in Selangor, the company operates in the logistics industry, focusing on cold chain transport and storage of frozen goods. 

Regarding ownership control, Gemilang Holdings Sdn. Bhd. holds a material majority stake of 70.0%, with individual shareholders Director 2 and Director 1 holding 19.45% and 10.55%, respectively. 

In litigation, the company acted as the plaintiff in a breach of contract case filed in the Magistrates' Court (Selangor) on 2023-09-24 with a claim amount of RM22,500.00; this matter is currently settled. 

No financial information, multi-year financial trends, audit opinions, or operating cash flow data are available, as no financial years or records are provided in the company record.

Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated on January 17, 1998, operating in the hospitality industry with its listed state as Kuala Lumpur and nature of business listed as operating a boutique hotel in Kuching.
